pages.mainText: Take the lead with Corporate Digital Identity Find out more keyboard_arrow_left keyboard_arrow_right CDI – the structured data foundation that powers AI-driven KYC In a world of surging client expectations and fierce competition, banks must embrace change to stay relevant. AI is accelerating that pressure, creating a new dividing line between banks that are ready and those that are not. How fast banks can accurately verify the identity of corporate clients is more critical than ever. Fragmented data, siloed systems, and manual processes don’t just create risk, they deprive AI initiatives of the clean, structured inputs they need to deliver. Corporate Digital Identity (CDI) changes that by replacing stale KYC records with a verified, real-time picture of every corporate client. The time to act is now – before falling behind becomes irreversible. Discover more EC360 platform Our award-winning CDI platform empowers banks with real-time insights and efficiency. Public and private data are seamlessly consolidated and organized. Manual processes are eliminated for faster, smarter decision-making. The result? Comprehensive, actionable risk profiles that drive compliance and growth and improve client experience. Learn about EC360 EC360 - delivering trusted AI-ready data Structured for AI CDI profiles are clean, normalized and data lineage tracked – essential for AI models to produce accurate, auditable outputs. API-first and AI-ready architecture EC360's open architecture delivers structured CDI data directly into your existing tech stack via a Model Context Protocol (MCP) and API - ready to connect to AI models, copilots and agentic workflows as your AI strategy matures. Powering responsible AI AI models need trustworthy input to consider KYC risk. EC360's CDI profiles provide this single source of truth. EC solutions Designed to enhance your existing tech stack and seamlessly integrate with digital transformation initiatives. Effortless collation of public KYC data and documents for fast and frictionless compliance. Find out more Flawless client collaboration and secure information exchange. h2s: We know that having access to the full picture can create business opportunities and empower businesses to fight financial crime
Encompass’ journey: Providing solutions for financial crime compliance
jsonLdDescriptions: Encompass has been helping companies fight financial crime since 2012. Explore our story, milestones & vision for financial crime compliance.
Encompass | Know Your Customer automation solutions
pages.mainText: The Encompass story: Fighting financial crime since 2012 Request a demo We know that having access to the full picture can create business opportunities and empower businesses to fight financial crime Following the successful exit of their big data visualization company, our founders, Wayne Johnson and Roger Carson, became investors. One of those investments proved costly, as they became victims of financial crime. Information on the parties involved that would have flagged this risk was available but inefficient and manual processes meant it was overlooked. With a clear and comprehensive picture of these parties, Wayne and Roger would have walked away from the deal. This experience led them to set up Encompass with the mission of enabling banks to create and maintain the identity of their corporate clients to create business opportunities, prevent financial crime and reduce regulatory risk. KYC has since become more complex and a significant differentiator for those who get it right. Client expectations are high, and corporate and institutional banks that can accurately verify the identity of clients faster than their peers have an important advantage. This led to the launch in February 2025 of our new Corporate Digital Identity (CDI) platform, EC360 to enable fast and flawless identity validation and verification of corporate clients. For the first time, publicly available and private client information are combined to create a reusable holistic view of clients. CDI represents a unique opportunity to elevate customer experience, streamline operations, and improve risk management. Now, with EC360 and our suite of EC solutions, banks can deliver the consumer-class service that corporate clients expect. Learn more about our co-founders Encompass’ journey: Providing solutions for financial crime compliance Since the launch of Encompass in 2012, we’ve been helping global banks and financial institutions to fight financial crime and streamline their KYC processes to comply with AML regulations and requirements. Take a look at the Encompass timeline and see the key milestones during our journey so far… 2012 Encompass launches in Australia, applying visual analytics to corporate, property and person information. 2014 We sign a major deal with international risk management and information business SAI Global (now Dye & Durham), granting exclusive rights to Encompass for the Australian market. 2015 Our global expansion starts as we launch in the UK, with offices in London and Glasgow. Secure data partnerships with leading business intelligence providers including Dun & Bradstreet, Bureau van Dijk and Equifax. 2016 We are first to automate Know Your Customer (KYC) searching using intelligent process automation. 2017 Our KYC automation products are launched to the market. Selected for UK Government's inaugural RegTech Mission to New York. 2018 Our expansion continues with the establishment of an office in Singapore, to drive sales, distribution and data partnerships throughout the APAC region. Partnership agreement signed with IHS Markit to automate their KYC discovery process. 2019 Strategic partnerships signed with Pegasystems and Dun & Bradstreet. 2020 We expand in Europe, opening an office in Belgrade. Selected as automation partner for Invidem, the Nordic KYC utility. Sign partnership with LexisNexis Risk Solutions. 2021 We launch Encompass in the North American market, with the opening of our offices in New York, and continue to expand our global footprint with a further office in Amsterdam. 2022 Named RegTech Partner of the Year by British Bank Awards. Win Aite-Novarica Group AML Impact Award for Best KYC Innovation. 2024 Encompass makes two acquisitions of ING-developed KYC platforms, CoorpID and Blacksmith KYC. 2025 We launch EC360, our Corporate Digital Identity (CDI) platform. 2025 Encompass wins Chartis FCC50 2025 Corporate Due Diligence emerging use case category award. 2025 Encompass closes latest funding round, led by BNP Paribas to fast-track further innovation in Corporate Digital Identity technology. 2025 We win Best AI Solution for KYC & AML Due Diligence in 2025 AI in Capital Markets awards. pages.mainText: The AI-ready Corporate Digital Identity platform Contact us Download the brochure Deliver consumer-class service to corporate clients worldwide EC360 is an award-winning corporate digital identity (CDI) platform designed to empower banks with unparalleled insights and efficiency. By seamlessly validating and verifying corporate clients, EC360 delivers a real-time, holistic, and AI-ready 360-vision of corporate identities. Our platform integrates global public data with private client information, seamlessly automating the collation of real-time documents and data while securely exchanging sensitive information. The result? Comprehensive, audit-ready digital risk profiles that eliminate manual processes and power AI models with a single, trusted source of truth for every corporate client. Orchestration EC360 seamlessly collects, organizes, and consolidates data from a bank’s approved public sources and with private sources client information to meet specific regulatory and business requirements. Automation rules streamline straight-through processing (STP) and ensure that only the most relevant information is consolidated into a unified, actionable output. Data ingestion Designed for flexibility, EC360 is data-agnostic and allows banks to tailor the information they want to collect on their clients. Public data Live connections to corporate and UBO registries, regulators and, stock exchanges, and data vendors provide real-time access to essential attributes and documents, including data from screening, identity verification (IDV), and business information vendors. Learn more Private data Secure outreach requests are automatically sent to clients to confirm the accuracy of existing information or provide additional details. Clients can store and share sensitive documents in a secure, private digital vault for streamlined communication. Learn more Strategic data management Advanced technologies enable seamless integration and intelligent use of the collected data. Data integration EC360 standardizes and normalizes data collated and extracted from documents through GenAI powered intelligent document processing (IDP). Advanced entity resolution techniques and hierarchy rules reconcile conflicts and construct a detailed beneficial ownership hierarchy. Screening and customization The platform enables automated screening of associated individuals uncovered. Secure client interaction EC Private Outreach facilitates secure, transparent communication with clients. A digital vault within EC CoorpID allows clients to manage requests, respond promptly, and keep private information up to date, all while maintaining full control over access and permissions. Dashboards Flexible, user-friendly dashboards offer end-to-end visibility, ensuring control and transparency across the data collection and management process. Output and monitoring The dynamic CDI profile combines verified public and private information into a AI-ready comprehensive digital record that includes: Original source documents Corporate hierarchy Full audit trail and data provenance This digital record can be maintained and continuously monitored as part of a perpetual KYC (pKYC) program, giving both compliance teams and AI models the accurate, up-to-date data they need to proactively manage risk. Attributes within the CDI are fully customizable and tailored to meet specific regulatory and operational needs. Learn more EC360 - delivering trusted AI-ready data Structured for AI CDI profiles are clean, normalized and data lineage tracked – essential for AI models to produce accurate, auditable outputs. API-first and AI-ready architecture EC360's open architecture delivers structured CDI data directly into your existing tech stack via a Model Context Protocol (MCP) and API - ready to connect to AI models, copilots and agentic workflows as your AI strategy matures. Powering responsible AI AI models need trustworthy input to consider KYC risk. EC360's CDI profiles provide this single source of truth. EC360 Model Context Protocol Connect your organization’s AI workflow with the power of KYC automation and corporate digital identity (CDI) with the EC360 MCP server. Learn more Working with Encompass EC360 is delivered as Software as a service (SaaS) and designed for seamless integration and accessible via an intuitive user interface (UI) or robust API. Digital profiles are available in multiple formats and enable effortless incorporation into existing banking systems including existing or third-party client lifecycle management (CLM) and workflow solutions. With the support of our global transformation team of KYC and banking industry experts, prebuilt integrations and strategic partnerships banks can achieve rapid deployment and long-term ROI realization. This combination of advanced features and proven expertise makes EC360 the strategic choice for banks seeking scalable, secure, and client-centric transformation. Find out what CDI could deliver for your organization. Calculate ROI Regulatory compliance and risk mitigation: Ensure robust adherence to global standards. Enhanced trust and reputation: Build confidence with clients and stakeholders. Operational efficiency: Achieve significant cost and time savings with automation. Superior client experience: Simplify and elevate every client interaction. Growth opportunities: Enable new business prospects with confidence and agility. Scalable, secure, reliable Security is at the core of EC360 and our EC solutions. Hosted across multiple cloud environments, EC360 adheres to the highest industry standards, including ISO 27001 certification, AICPA SOC 2 Type II compliance, and EU GDPR/UK DPA alignment. All data is encrypted both at rest and in transit, with regular backup and recovery testing ensuring resilience and reliability. At Encompass Corporation, our goal has always been to empower banks to optimize their KYC processes, strengthen risk management, and meet compliance standards—all while driving greater efficiency. With EC360, we’ve designed a solution that delivers this transformative approach. The time to act is now and as banking continues to evolve, so must the systems that support it. CEO and Co-founder | Wayne Johnson Find out more CDI lifecycle Watch this video to understand the key stages required to develop a CDI. Find out more FAQs What is EC360? EC360 is Encompass Corporation’s award-winning Corporate Digital Identity (CDI) platform. It validates and verifies the identity of corporate clients in real time by combining global public data with private client information, creating comprehensive, audit-ready CDI profiles that banks use for KYC onboarding, due diligence, and ongoing compliance. What is a Corporate Digital Identity (CDI) profile? A CDI profile is a dynamic, AI-ready digital record of a corporate client that combines verified public and private data, including original source documents, corporate hierarchy, and a full audit trail with data provenance. CDI profiles are used by both compliance teams and AI models as a single, trusted source of truth for KYC risk management. How does EC360 support AI-driven KYC? EC360 is built for AI-driven KYC workflows. It uses GenAI-powered intelligent document processing (IDP) to standardize and normalize data at ingestion, and outputs audit-ready CDI profiles that give AI models the accurate, verified, and traceable data they need to power automated risk decisioning, intelligent onboarding copilots, and perpetual KYC programs. What data sources does EC360 use? EC360 connects to a broad range of global public data sources including corporate and UBO registries, regulators, stock exchanges, and data vendors, providing real-time access to corporate attributes, documents, screening, and identity verification data. It also incorporates private client data through secure outreach, combining both into a unified CDI profile. Does EC360 integrate with existing banking systems? Yes. EC360 is designed to integrate seamlessly with existing banking technology stacks via its open API. It supports straight-through processing (STP) and delivers structured CDI data directly into core banking applications, CLM systems, and AI-driven workflows. What is perpetual KYC (pKYC) and how does EC360 support it? Perpetual KYC (pKYC) is a continuous approach to client monitoring that replaces periodic reviews with real-time risk management. EC360 supports pKYC by maintaining and continuously monitoring CDI profiles, ensuring compliance teams and AI models always have access to accurate, up-to-date corporate identity data. Which banks use EC360? EC360 is trusted by some of the world’s leading banks, including BNP Paribas, ING, RBC Capital Markets, NAB, and SEB, to power their KYC onboarding, due diligence, and compliance programs. Which browsers do you support? The EC360 platform and solutions are optimized for Google Chrome. Other Chromium-based browsers such as Microsoft Edge, Brave, and Opera are also supported, though some features may behave differently depending on your browser’s settings. If you experience any issues accessing the solution on your preferred browser, please get in touch via the helpdesk or live chat.
